title: Pinned unshifted restriction of a representing pullback Hom cocone
statement: Let R:I -> CommRingCat be a preorder-indexed diagram with cocone c and i in I. Let s:Y -> Spec(R_i), B an open of Y, and a an adjunction derivedPullback(B.ι) left adjoint to schemeDerivedDirectImage(B.ι). Assume the derived categories exist on every scheme. Let Q be a derived object on Y and F,d a cocone carrying PerfectHomPushPullData h for R,c,s,Q. Write L=schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B. There exists hB:PerfectHomPushPullData R c (B.ι followed by s) (LQ) (F composed with L) (L.mapCocone d). Its stage equivalence at LM applied to Lf equals perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map(R.map(i<=j))) a applied to h.stageEquiv j M f, for every j,M,f. Its apex equivalence satisfies the same equation using Spec.map(c.ι_i) and h.limitEquiv. The restriction map is explicitly constructed by pullback.map along B.ι and conjugation by the composite of perfectHomComposition, eqToIso of its fst equation, the inverse second composition comparison, and the mate of the identity between a and schemeMVAdjunction. Thus the statement pins the equivalences on restricted testing objects to an explicit map; it is not the shifted open-stage-maps item under another name. [lem-pc-perfect-hom-push-pull-cocone, def-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-canonical-data, lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport].

lean.statement:
theorem perfect_hom_open_restricted_data
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R)
    {i : I} {Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (B : Y.Opens)
    (a : derivedPullback B.ι ⊣ schemeDerivedDirectImage B.ι)
    (Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (F : Set.Ici i ⥤ schemeDerivedCategory Y) (d : Cocone F)
    (h : PerfectHomPushPullData R c s Q F d) :
    let L := schemeMVDerivedRestriction Y B
    ∃ hB : PerfectHomPushPullData R c (B.ι ≫ s) (L.obj Q) (F ⋙ L) (L.mapCocone d),
      (∀ (j : Set.Ici i) (M : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (f : M ⟶ F.obj j),
        hB.stageEquiv j (L.obj M) (L.map f) =
          perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (R.map (homOfLE j.property))) a
            (h.stageEquiv j M f)) ∧
      (∀ (M : schemeDerivedCategory Y) (f : M ⟶ d.pt),
        hB.limitEquiv (L.obj M) (L.map f) =
          perfectHomOpenRestrictionMap s B (Spec.map (c.ι.app i)) a (h.limitEquiv M f))
